logline: 비 오는 날 손님이 끊이지 않는 인력거꾼이, 벌수록 집으로 가는 걸음을 미룬다.
destination: 집 문 앞 — 하루 종일 미뤄온 귀가
anchor: a wiry rickshaw puller in soaked hemp clothes and a headband, bare calves
palette: rain grey, gaslight ochre, wet cobble sheen, cold blue dusk

beats.beat: 침상에 누웠던 인력거꾼이 일어나 신을 조인다.
beats.visual: a wiry man rising from a floor mat in a dim room, tightening straw sandals at the doorsill
beats.motion: he pushes off the floor, straps pull tight, rain drums on the roof

beats.beat: 그는 인력거를 끌고 인파 속으로 들어선다.
beats.visual: a man pulling a two-wheeled rickshaw into a crowded rainy street, umbrellas pressing around him
beats.motion: the wheels roll into the crowd, umbrellas jostle, rain sheets across the road

beats.beat: 손님이 끊이지 않아 그는 헐떡이며 달린다.
beats.visual: a rickshaw puller running hard through rain, a seated passenger behind, wet road stretching ahead
beats.motion: his legs pump fast, water sprays from the wheels, his shoulders heave

beats.beat: 노을 무렵 그는 주머니를 자꾸 만져 본다.
beats.visual: a man halted between the shafts of a rickshaw, one hand pressed flat against his waist pouch
beats.motion: his hand presses and releases, the shafts tilt, evening light reddens the puddles

beats.beat: 술집 문 앞에서 친구와 부딪혀 안으로 들어간다.
beats.visual: two men in wet clothes pushing through a low tavern doorway, steam and lamplight spilling out
beats.motion: the door cloth swings aside, steam rolls out, both men duck through

beats.beat: 설렁탕 그릇을 들고 그는 어두운 계단을 오른다.
beats.visual: a man carrying a covered soup bowl with both hands up a narrow dark stair, one bare bulb above
beats.motion: he climbs upward one step at a time, the bowl tilts with each rise, the bulb sways overhead

beats.beat: 그가 들고 있던 그릇은 어떻게 될까?
beats.visual: a covered soup bowl tilting in a man's hands at a dark doorway, faint light on the floor mat
beats.motion: the bowl tips forward, lid slides, his knees begin to give

beats.beat: 빗속 골목에 인력거 한 대가 서 있다.
beats.visual: an empty two-wheeled rickshaw standing in a rainy alley under a gaslight, shafts down
beats.motion: rain streaks past the lamp, a wheel turns once, puddles ripple

withheld: 방 안에서 기다리던 사람이 이미 숨을 거두었다는 것
